author: Stannis
text_post: I'm actually intent on trying to improve my lot this year. I've now spent a decade stuck in this liminal state, stagnating and interminably pendulating between inertia and delirium. Although I've felt this way before and it was never enough to get me to be proactive. Still, there is nothing worse than life passing you by in front of your eyes because you're too comfortable and risk-averse to actively partake in it. The only questions remaining are whether I do have the capacity for change in the first place and whether or not this change will yield positive results.
